name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's obsession with motorsport began early, fuelled by weekends spent at the Nürburgring with his father. He quickly became fascinated by the artistry of race car liveries, spending hours sketching designs and studying the intricacies of paint application. After completing a rigorous apprenticeship in automotive painting, he honed his skills at a renowned custom shop specializing in high-end vehicles. He has a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to perfectly match any color, ensuring that every vehicle leaving his workshop is a masterpiece. Klaus-Dieter thrives on the challenge of bringing innovative designs to life, always seeking new techniques and materials to elevate the visual impact of race cars.

His calm demeanor and unwavering focus make him a valuable asset in the high-pressure environment of motorsport. Klaus-Dieter approaches each project with a blend of technical precision and artistic flair, striving not only for flawless execution but also for a deep understanding of the team's vision. He believes that a well-executed paint job can be a crucial element of a team's identity and success, contributing to both visual appeal and aerodynamic performance through optimized paint application techniques.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is of average height, with a wiry build honed from years of detailed work.

quirks: Always wears pristine white overalls, no matter how messy the job
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus
Keeps a small magnifying glass on his workbench for inspecting paint finishes
